qualifications: The three lock tests are included in the 24-test native base-refresh store filter; counts overlap.

Core publication R1 failed when Gitleaks flagged five fixture UUID operation/decision fields. That failed receipt and packet are preserved. R3 extends stable aliases to these fixture fields, retaining equality and unchanged secret-scanning policy; it is a new validation attempt, not a rewritten R1 pass.

Initial evidence assembly rejected an unsanitized personal path in a JSON object key. The failed partial packet is preserved locally; the retry redacts keys and values and rejects key collisions without changing the validated product source.
Canonical ignored SQLx tests are reported separately; the focused native lane invokes the owned-database base-refresh tests explicitly.
First lock-regression attempt failed during prerequisite setup; the corrected R2 reproduced three real deadlocks; R3 passed. All attempts are retained.
Browser/provider and GitHub boundaries use deterministic fixtures; no live external provider or GitHub publication is claimed by acceptance.
Source metadata is checked at fresh boundaries; no historical metadata or continuous operating-system lock is claimed.
Actual Node runtime 24.21.0 differs from the repository declaration 24.19.0.
No hosted CI, CodeQL, independent approval, issue completion or clean historical Cargo advisory audit is claimed.
